context.body: Solomon’s Temple prayer becomes part of a wider argument about prayer, time, and final judgment.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: Ezra asks whether the righteous can intercede after judgment and names Solomon among earlier figures who prayed for others in the present age.
observations.label: Solomon’s prayer becomes an example of intercession: action

observations.body: The interpreting voice distinguishes present intercession from the finality of judgment.
observations.label: Solomon’s prayer becomes an example of intercession: response

observations.body: Solomon for those who worshiped in the sanctuary · prayed for the weak · day of judgment
observations.label: Words in 2 Esdras 7:100–115

payload.posture: Read 2 Esdras 7:100–115 as later memory and aftermath evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The passage remembers one function of Solomon’s prayer while advancing a later apocalyptic distinction.
payload.title: Solomon’s prayer becomes an example of intercession
